questions.s: Which case recognized that the Preamble is a part of the Indian Constitution ?
questions.x: In Kesavananda Bharati (1973) the Supreme Court held that the Preamble is part of the Constitution.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: The ideals of "liberty, equality and fraternity" in the Preamble have been taken from the ______ Revolution.
questions.x: Liberty, equality and fraternity come from the French Revolution.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: The two additional words "Socialist" and "Secular" were added to the Indian Constitution by the ______ Amendment.
questions.x: The 42nd Amendment (1976) added "Socialist" and "Secular" to the Preamble.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Which Article of Indian Constitution says that 'untouchability' is abolished ?
questions.x: Article 17 abolishes untouchability.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: One of the following is written by Granville Austin :
o: Introduction to the Study of the Law of the Constitution
The Indian Constitution — Cornerstone of a Nation
Some Characteristics of the Indian Constitution
questions.x: Granville Austin wrote "The Indian Constitution: Cornerstone of a Nation" (1966).
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: The Fundamental Rights are enshrined in which part of the Indian Constitution ?
questions.x: Fundamental Rights are in Part III (Articles 12-35).
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: "The State shall not deny to any person equality before the law... ." Which Article of the Indian Constitution provides the above ?
questions.x: Article 14 guarantees equality before the law and equal protection of the laws.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: The 86th Amendment of the Indian Constitution made primary education as a Fundamental Right in the year
questions.x: The 86th Amendment Act, 2002 inserted Article 21A, making education for children of 6-14 a fundamental right.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: What is meant by "Quo Warranto" ?
questions.x: Quo warranto means "by what authority"; it asks a holder of public office to show their right to it.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Who was the Prime Minister of India when the Maintenance of Internal Security Act (MISA) was passed by the Parliament ?
questions.x: MISA was passed in 1971 when Indira Gandhi was Prime Minister.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: "Right to Property" was deleted by the ______ Amendment of the Indian Constitution.
questions.x: The 44th Amendment (1978) removed the right to property from the Fundamental Rights.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Who is regarded as the "Father of Local Self-Government" ?
questions.x: Lord Ripon's resolution of 1882 earned him the title "Father of Local Self-Government".
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Who was the Prime Minister of India when Ashok Mehta Committee on Panchayati Raj was set up ?
questions.x: The Ashok Mehta Committee was appointed in 1977 under Prime Minister Morarji Desai.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: In 1986, the Rajiv Gandhi Government constituted a committee on "Revitalisation of Panchayati Raj institutions for democracy and development". Who was the Chairman of the Committee ?
questions.x: The L.M. Singhvi Committee (1986) was on revitalising Panchayati Raj institutions for democracy and development.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: One of the following was not a feature of the 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1992 :
questions.x: The 73rd Amendment set up a three-tier system (village, intermediate, district), not two-tier.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Eleventh Schedule of the Indian Constitution contains ______ functional items.
questions.x: The Eleventh Schedule lists 29 subjects for panchayats.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: The first Municipal Corporation in India was set up at
questions.x: Madras had India's first municipal corporation, in 1688.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Twelfth Schedule of the Indian Constitution contains ______ functional items.
questions.x: The Twelfth Schedule lists 18 subjects for municipalities.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: The 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act applies to one of the following states :
questions.x: Nagaland, Meghalaya and Mizoram are exempt from Part IX, but it applies to Orissa.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: The Community Development Programme was started in the year
questions.x: The Community Development Programme began on 2 October 1952.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Who was the Chairman of the Grow More Food Inquiry Committee ?
questions.x: V.T. Krishnamachari chaired the Grow More Food Enquiry Committee (1952).
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Ashok Mehta Committee recommended the ______ tier system of Panchayati Raj.
questions.x: The Ashok Mehta Committee (1978) recommended a two-tier system (Zilla Parishad and Mandal Panchayat).
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: "The State shall take steps to organise Village Panchayats." Which Article of the Indian Constitution states it ?
questions.x: Article 40, a Directive Principle, asks the State to organise village panchayats.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Which was the first Urban Development Authority set up in India in 1964 ?
questions.x: The key gives the Delhi Development Authority as the first urban development authority.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: By which Constitutional Amendment Act, were Municipalities given Constitutional status (by inserting in Part IX A) ?
questions.x: The 74th Amendment (1992) inserted Part IX-A on Municipalities.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: "Economic and Social Planning" is in the ______ List of the Indian Constitution.
questions.x: "Economic and social planning" is entry 20 of the Concurrent List.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: One of the following is not a constitutional agency :
questions.x: The Planning Commission was set up by a 1950 executive resolution, not by the Constitution.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Indian Foreign Service is a/an
questions.x: The Indian Foreign Service is a Central (Group A) Service, not an All-India Service.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: The National Development Council was formed in the year
questions.x: The National Development Council was set up in August 1952.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: The Zonal Councils have been established by the
questions.x: Zonal Councils were created by the States Reorganisation Act, 1956.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: One of the following has a federal form of government :
questions.x: Argentina has a federal constitution; Britain, Italy and France are unitary.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: The State of Andhra Pradesh was kept under President's Rule in the year
questions.x: Andhra Pradesh was under President's Rule in 1973 during the Jai Andhra agitation.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Who described the Indian Constitution as "Quasi-federal" ?
questions.x: K.C. Wheare called the Indian Constitution "quasi-federal".
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Which Finance Commission recommended that out of Central revenues, twenty-nine percent should go to the States ?
questions.x: The Tenth Finance Commission (K.C. Pant) recommended giving 29 percent of central revenues to the States.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: The political system adopted in the Constitution could be "both unitary as well as federal according to the requirements of time and circumstances". Who said this ?
questions.x: Ambedkar told the Constituent Assembly the Constitution could be both unitary and federal as time and circumstances required.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: The Balwant Rai Mehta Committee submitted its report in
questions.x: The Balwant Rai Mehta Committee submitted its report in 1957.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution
